posts.alt: 2026 Topps Chrome WWE Lita Rebel by Design on-card autograph, numbered 02/10.
posts.fb:
In 1997, Amy Dumas watched Rey Mysterio on Nitro, decided that was the life she wanted, moved to Mexico with no money and no connections, and paid for her own wrestling training by dancing in a club at night. 🌹

That's not a motivational poster. That's just what she did.

Seven years later she was main eventing Raw. She's in the first three women's main events in Raw history — and she won all three. Four-time champion. Hall of Fame, inducted by Trish Stratus. Also fronted a punk band called The Luchagors, because obviously she did.

2026 Topps Chrome WWE — Rebel by Design, on-card autograph, card #LIT1, hand-numbered 02/10. Ten exist anywhere. This is number two.

The design is loud, messy and slightly unhinged, which is frankly the only respectful way to put Lita on a trading card.

posts.alt: 2026 Topps Cosmic Chrome WWE Triple H Legends autograph card.
posts.fb:
In 1996, Triple H broke character at Madison Square Garden to hug his friends goodbye on their way out the door. WWE punished him by taking his King of the Ring win away. ✍️

They gave it to Steve Austin instead.

Austin used the winner's promo to say "Austin 3:16" — which became the best-selling shirt in wrestling history and roughly printed the money that won the Monday Night Wars.

So Triple H got punished, and it accidentally created the biggest star the business has ever produced. He then spent the next thirty years earning it back — 14 world championships — and today he's WWE's Chief Content Officer, which means he books the show that once buried him.

2026 Topps Cosmic Chrome WWE — Legends Autograph, card #CCA-HHH.

Best refractor finish Topps has put out in years. The photo undersells it, but no photo of a refractor has ever not undersold it. Permanent curse of the hobby.

→ https://www.ebay.com/itm/318731377972

posts.alt: 2026 Topps Chrome WWE Garbage Pail Kids Damian Priest refractor short print card.
posts.fb:
Damian Priest won two national championships in full-contact martial arts, trained by his own father. He keeps katanas, sai and nunchucks in his house. His favourite bands are Slayer and Pantera. 🏹

Topps looked at all of that and drew him as a cartoon toddler full of arrows, named him "DAMAGED DAMIAN," and put it on a card.

Someone pitched that in a meeting. Every person in the room said yes. That person is employed. That person is thriving.

2026 Topps Chrome WWE × Garbage Pail Kids, card #GPK-DP. Refractor short print, and a genuine case hit — not a card you casually stumble into.

The GPK crossover is the most fun anybody's had with a wrestling set in ten years, and this is the standout of the run. It rainbows so hard in hand that photographing it is basically a formality.

→ https://www.ebay.com/itm/318731525182
